responsibility: Defines the Rust-side FFI data layout for LLVM coverage mapping and MC/DC metadata, converting rustc MIR coverage terms and source regions into C-compatible structs and enums whose memory layout matches the llvm-wrapper interfaces.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `llvm/ffi.rs`, this FFI file is narrowly for coverage instrumentation: it defines the ABI-matching structs and enums passed to the coverage map/wrapper layer, including counters, expressions, source regions, and MC/DC parameters derived from MIR coverage data. It does not declare the general LLVM C API or wrapper function bindings used across the backend.
